changed: scripts/repo_move.py gains named move sets: `layout --set <name>` and `check --set <name>` (default `packages`, unchanged behaviour; an unknown name raises `unknown move set`). The new `plugins` set git-moves src/e_agent/erp to src/e_agent/plugins/erp/domain and src/e_agent/adapters/odoo to src/e_agent/plugins/erp/odoo, with tests/unit/erp and tests/unit/adapters/odoo moved to tests/unit/plugins/erp/{domain,odoo}. In tracked .py, .toml and .json files it rewrites dotted and slash module paths (imports, entry points, hook `package`, manifest `factory`, script module strings) with one longest-first, token-bounded regex. It never creates __init__.py under src/, refuses untracked non-cache files in the moved trees, rewrites relative Markdown links, and excludes archive/, research/, harness/state/, docs/handoffs/ and the mover's own two files from text rewriting. `check --set plugins` lists old-path leftovers in code and config (and docs with --docs). The real move has not been run; that is 1d.10. A fresh-context review (rework: R-1 High, R-2 Medium, R-3 to R-5 Low) led to: the 1d.10 plan steps now run `check --set plugins --docs` (the default set passed vacuously), hand-edit short paths, and run ruff fix and format (8235aff); the plugin tests now hold a decoy under every rewrite exemption and for both regex lookbehinds, so the reviewer's mutants fail, and git-ignored non-cache files in a moved tree are refused (612c017). A scoped re-review confirmed both fixes (R-8, R-9) and asked for this bookkeeping (R-7).
open_items: Task 1d.10 runs `layout --set plugins` on the real repo; a dry `check --set plugins` today lists 108 old-path references in 31 code and config files and 11 in 4 Markdown files.

Task 1d.10 edits by hand what the mover cannot see: the split names in tests/conformance/test_repo_layout.py, the import-linter contracts in pyproject.toml, and ERP_MODULES in scripts/check_core_only.py (now listed in the plan).
mypy's configured packages do not include scripts/; repo_move.py passes `mypy --strict` when run directly but the full gate does not type-check it.

The quick smoke gate without --package runs `pytest -q .`, which collects the git-ignored local evidence/review/test_review_probes.py and fails; the first quick evidence file (09-18-43) records that failure, and the rerun with --package tests/conformance passed.

Optional, from re-review R-9: _drop_caches removes only __pycache__ while _is_cache also accepts .pytest_cache, .mypy_cache and .ruff_cache, which git mv carries to the new location; harmless caches, left as is.
Optional, from re-review R-8: the 1d.10 short-path grep also hits harness/state and the mover's fixtures; read its output as a discovery list, not a check.

rulings.ruling: The red step failed with argparse rejecting `--set` rather than with `unknown move set`; the unknown-name error is its own test for both layout and check (plan step annotated).
rulings.cost_if_wrong: None for behaviour; the red was for a missing CLI option, which the same tests now cover.

rulings.ruling: Markdown text is not rewritten by the plugins set; only relative links are, across every tracked .md outside archive/ and research/, as `links --layout` does, so links in docs/handoffs and docs/plans pointing into the moved trees are fixed while their prose keeps the old names.
rulings.cost_if_wrong: 1d.10 hand-edits the current docs that `check --set plugins --docs` lists (README and three design docs); if history links should stay unchanged, revert those link edits in the 1d.10 commit.

rulings.ruling: Non-Markdown, non-code text files (Makefile, YAML, txt) count as docs in `check --set plugins` and fail it only with --docs.
rulings.cost_if_wrong: A stale path in CI YAML would pass `check` without --docs; 1d.10 runs `check --docs`, so it is still caught there.
